# Session Messenger 会话信使

Hand off work between **top-level DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions** in the same
workspace: list sibl

ing sessions, send a one-way message, or create a new parent
session and hand it a summary.
The plugin has two halves:

- **Host** — three tools: `list_sessions`, `send_session_message`, `create_session`.
- **Client** —

a **转交 / Hand off** button at the left of the composer, with a
session picker and message box.

Both paths deliver plain text through the session controller in `queue` mode.
Delivery is fire-and-f

orget: the sender returns as soon as the message is
accepted, and the recipient's answer stays in th
e recipient's session.

> Published on npm as `dsh-session-messenger-plugin`.
>
> **Community project.** Not affiliated with

, endorsed by, or maintained by
> DeepSeek AI.
## Requirements

- A DSH desktop build with plugin support and the Web UI.
- The `dsh` CLI with `dsh plugin` support

(or the agent-facing `plugin_manager`
tool for local development).
- No build step: the plugin is pl
ain ESM plus a browser module.

## Use
### 1. Agent tools
Ask the agent in the source session:
> Summarize the current work and send it to the session titled “Test session 1”.
The agent will call:

1. `list_sessions({ "query": "Test session 1" })` to get the exact id.
2. `send_session_message({ "s
essionId": "session-…", "message": "…" })`.
To create a new parent session and hand it work:
> Create a new session titled “Handoff: auth refactor” and send it this summary.
The agent will call `create_session({ "title": "…", "message": "…" })`.
### 2. 转交 / Hand off button
The button sits at the left of the composer tool row. It opens a dialog with:

- a search box (title or session id);
- the list of other **top-level** sessions in the **same works

Archived sessions are hidden from this list. Subagent sessions and sessions in
other workspaces are

sions are hidden from this list. Subagent sessions and sessions in
other workspaces are never shown.
### 3. Reply semantics

By default a message is informational; the recipient is not asked to answer.
The envelope header say
s `无需回复` / `no reply needed`.

Set `replyRequested: true` (Host tool) or tick the checkbox (UI) only when the
user explicitly asks

for an answer. The header then says `请求回复` / `reply
requested`, and the recipient may call `send_ses

sion_message` back to the
sender's session.

There is **no request/response correlation or inbox**: a reply is an ordinary
new message in the oth
er session. The sender does not wait for it.
## Message format
Host tools wrap the body in a plain-text envelope:

With `replyRequested: true` the last field is `请求回复`. The envelope is
ordinary user-visible text, so

it works with any model and any session log; no
custom event type is added.

appear in `list_sessio

ns`. Delivery uses `sessionController.prompt` with
`mode: "queue"`: an idle session starts a turn, a

running session receives the
message after its current turn. The call does not interrupt the recipi

## Boundaries and limitations

- **Same workspace only.** No cross-workspace or cross-machine messaging.
- **Top-level parent sessi

ons only.** Subagents are excluded from listing and
cannot be targeted.
- **Text only.** No attachme

nts, images, or file parts.
- **No broadcast.** One target per call.
- **No request/response correla

tion.** `replyRequested` only changes the
envelope wording; it does not create an inbox or promise a

reply.
- **No archive/deletion of the target session.** Archiving only hides the
session from the t

ransfer dialog; it does not delete it.
- **20,000-character message limit** (the envelope is additio

er dialog; it does not delete it.
- **20,000-character message limit** (the envelope is additional).
## Privacy

The plugin has no telemetry and makes no network requests of its own. Messages
are written into the

two sessions' normal logs and are sent to the model through
whatever provider the DSH profile alread

y uses. The UI uses DSH theme tokens and
does not inject a second application or load remote assets.
